what_happened: The retry job to add a role-need measure to athena status (OLY-9-11) was rejected at the final verdict. The new "role need planner" status line is always printed (role_need_section in display.rs:1339). That broke an existing test in crates/athena-cli/tests/job_plan.rs:1512, so the test check failed (shard 5 of 6, athena-cli --test job_plan). The one unmet acceptance criterion is the one requiring cargo fmt --check, clippy and cargo test to pass. The verifier also gave a major finding: behavior criterion 5 is unmet because its evidence must cite commands that ran (D43). The kept test output shows only passing lines from another test, so the failing assertion is not visible in it.
cause: Nothing made the producer find the existing tests that read the output it was changing before it finished. The new section was printed unconditionally, and no step ran the full athena-cli test suite, or the tests that read status or plan output, against that change. The breakage showed up only in the final sharded test check. The behavior-evidence rule (D43) was again not tied to commands the producer ran.
other_causes: The kept test output shows only a passing shard's lines, so the producer and verifier cannot see the failing assertion in job_plan.rs.
The retry may not have carried over what the earlier attempt learned about this feature's test impact.
open_hypotheses: Whether the producer ran cargo test at all before finishing is not shown.
Whether job_plan.rs:1512 asserts exact status text or just the absence of a role-need line is not shown, so whether the line should be conditional or the test updated is open.
contradictions: The kept failed-check output shows only passing tests and no job_plan failure detail, though the verifier names the specific line, so the cause is known from the verifier's finding rather than the check output.
prevention: Before the producer reports done, require it to run the full athena-cli test suite whenever it changes shared output code such as display.rs. The check should record the failing test name and assertion in the kept evidence. For any change to printed output, the reading should also list the existing tests that read that output, so the producer updates or accounts for them. This rule would catch the whole class: a change to shared output breaks existing tests and is found only at the end. The gate counts show no disagreements, so no gate needs relaxing.
proposed_request: Add a role-need measure to athena status for OLY-9-11 (retry of 20261111-105048-n7bm). Outcome: athena status shows which roles are needed or should be retired, using evidence that includes roles whose runs are outside job invocations. Before finishing, find every existing test that reads athena status or plan output (start with crates/athena-cli/tests/job_plan.rs near line 1512) and either print the role-need line only when it has something to report or update those tests deliberately. Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and the full cargo test, including xtask/tests/spec.rs, and cite those commands as evidence for each behavior criterion (D43). Add the CHANGELOG.md entry.
